items.markdown:
Phuket is famous for its unique Peranakan and Southern Thai flavors, with must-try dishes including **Moo Hong** (slow-braised pork belly), **Hokkien Mee** (stir-fried yellow noodles), and local **Dim Sum**.[](https://www.marionskitchen.com/article/what-to-eat-phuket-food-tour-travel/) [[1]](https://www.marionskitchen.com/article/what-to-eat-phuket-food-tour-travel/)[[2]](https://www.thavornbeachvillage.com/tips-must-try-thai-dishes-to-dine-on-in-phuket)[[3]](https://www.notquitenigella.com/2018/11/16/phuket-local-street-food-guide/)[[4]](https://h-paper.hplhotels.com/phuket-food-guide-5-local-dishes-to-try/)

Iconic Local Dishes

- **Moo Hong:** Tender, sweet, and savory slow-braised pork belly flavored with garlic and pepper.
- **Hokkien Mee:** Thick yellow egg noodles tossed with seafood, pork, and rich soy sauce.
- **Lo Ba:** Deep-fried marinated pork offal served with tofu and a sweet-spicy dipping sauce.
- **O-Aew:** A refreshing, traditional shaved ice dessert made from banana jelly and kidney beans.[](https://www.marionskitchen.com/article/what-to-eat-phuket-food-tour-travel/) [[1]](https://www.excursionmania.com/tirp_idea/a-food-lover-s-guide-to-phuket-best-local-dishes-where-to-eat-blg-1814)[[2]](https://h-paper.hplhotels.com/phuket-food-guide-5-local-dishes-to-try/)

Famous Places to Eat

- **One Chun Café & Restaurant:** A popular [MICHELIN Guide](https://guide.michelin.com/gb/en/phuket-region/phuket/restaurants) spot in Phuket Town serving authentic family-recipe southern Thai dishes like crab curry.
- **Go Benz:** A legendary late-night stall known for its crispy pork and peppery rice noodle soup.
- **Laem Hin Seafood:** A scenic coastal restaurant ideal for tasting fresh local fish and prawns right by the water.[](https://guide.michelin.com/gb/en/phuket-region/phuket/restaurants) [[1]](https://guide.michelin.com/gb/en/phuket-region/phuket/restaurants)[[2]](https://guide.michelin.com/ae-az/en/article/travel/where-to-eat-sleep-and-play-in-phuket-old-town)[[3]](https://www.jamiesphuketblog.com/2006/06/restaurants-food-and-drink.html)[[4]](https://www.midnightblueelephant.com/phuket-old-town-thailand/)[[5]](https://www.e-table.asia/best-thai-restaurants-in-phuket-phukets-authentic-thai-restaurants-with-great-atmosphere/)
